BiblicalUsage: Ben-Ammi means "son of my people." He was son of Lot, born to his second daughter, progenitor of the Ammonites. You will find it in Genesis 19:38.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Ben-Ammi is in Scripture for a reason, and no name there is an accident.
